label: Bromo Sunrise Start
description: Pickup from hotel at 03:00–03:30 AM. Transfer by private car to Penanjakan I viewpoint area (~1 hour). Arrive before dawn for sunrise viewing.

label: Ijen Midnight Start
description: Depart from hotel/villa at 00:00–00:30. Drive ~1.5 hours to Paltuding basecamp. Register, rent gas masks if needed, begin ascent by 02:00 AM.

label: Bromo Mid-Morning Start
description: Pickup from hotel at 06:00 AM. Drive to Sea of Sand jeep station. Transfer by private jeep to crater rim area. Morning exploration at Bromo.

label: Madakaripura Morning Start
description: Depart from Probolinggo hotel at 08:00 AM. Drive ~45 minutes to Madakaripura parking area. Begin jungle trail to waterfall (~30 min walk).

label: Tumpak Sewu Morning Start
description: Depart from Lumajang/Artha Cottage at 07:00 AM. Drive ~30 minutes to Tumpak Sewu viewpoint. Begin guided descent to waterfall base (~45 min).

label: Papuma Afternoon Start
description: Depart from Jember hotel at 14:00. Drive ~1 hour to Papuma Beach. Arrive for sunset viewing and beach exploration until 18:00.

label: Surabaya City Tour Start
description: Depart from Surabaya hotel at 08:30 AM. Begin city tour covering House of Sampoerna, Tugu Pahlawan, Submarine Museum, and Ampel Mosque.

label: Malang City Tour Start
description: Depart from Malang hotel at 08:00 AM. City tour to Jodipan Colorful Village, Batu town area, Alun-alun, and local culinary stops.

label: Taman Safari Morning Start
description: Depart from Surabaya/Malang hotel at 08:00 AM. Drive ~1.5 hours to Taman Safari Prigen. Entry at opening (09:00). Safari drive followed by Baby Zoo.

label: Coffee Technopark Morning Start
description: Depart from Bondowoso/Jember hotel at 08:30 AM. Drive to Coffee & Cocoa Science Technopark. Guided plantation tour and tasting session.

label: Bromo Afternoon Check-In
description: Arrive at Bromo area hotel/villa from Surabaya or Malang. Check-in, rest, prepare gear for early morning Bromo sunrise tour next day.

label: Ijen Pre-Trek Check-In
description: Arrive at Banyuwangi/Bondowoso area hotel/villa. Check-in early evening. Set alarm for midnight departure to Ijen. Prepare trekking gear.

label: Malang Arrival Start
description: Arrive in Malang city from previous destination. Transfer to city hotel. Optional afternoon visit to Batu town or rest.

label: Surabaya Arrival Start
description: Arrive in Surabaya from previous destination. Transfer to city hotel. Optional evening visit to Suramadu Bridge or Kenjeran Beach.

label: Tumpak Sewu via Lumajang
description: Depart Malang hotel early AM. Drive ~2.5 hours to Pronojiwo, Lumajang. Check in at Artha Cottage or proceed directly to Tumpak Sewu trailhead.

label: Madakaripura via Probolinggo
description: Depart Bromo hotel at 06:30 AM (post-sunrise). Drive ~1 hour to Madakaripura parking. Complete waterfall trek then continue to next destination.

label: Papuma Morning Start
description: Depart from Jember hotel at 08:00 AM. Drive ~1 hour to Papuma Beach. Morning beach exploration and cliff walks until early afternoon.

label: Ijen Post-Sunrise Start
description: Return to hotel after Ijen trek (~08:00–09:00 AM). Breakfast and shower. Depart to next destination after rest (10:00–11:00 AM).

label: Bromo Post-Sunrise Continue
description: Return from Bromo viewpoint/crater. Breakfast at hotel. Check-out and continue to next destination (Ijen, Malang, or Surabaya) by 09:00–10:00 AM.

label: Surabaya Departure Day
description: Morning free time or short city activity. Proceed to Juanda Airport or Surabaya train station for departure. Estimated airport arrival 2–3 hours before flight.
